kept.title: CSP nonce never reaches Next.js's own scripts
kept.desc: Next.js extracts the nonce for its bootstrap/hydration `<script>` tags from the **incoming request's** `Content-Security-Policy` header, so the CSP must also be set on `requestHeaders` (as in Next's own docs), not just on the response. As written, Next's scripts are emitted without `nonce`, and because `'strict-dynamic'` causes `'self'` to be ignored in `script-src`, every script is blocked and the app fails to hydrate.

kept.title: Comment states a mechanism that doesn't exist
kept.desc: "Next.js automatically tags its own bootstrap `<script>` elements with the nonce from the response's CSP header" is wrong — Next reads the CSP from the request headers forwarded by the proxy; this incorrect assumption is what causes finding 1 and will mislead future maintainers debugging blocked scripts.

kept.title: Dev mode will break without `'unsafe-eval'`
kept.desc: Next.js's development server (HMR / Fast Refresh, React refresh runtime) uses `eval`, which this `script-src` forbids; a dev-only relaxation (`process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"`) is normally required or local development is unusable.

kept.title: `x-nonce` request header is dead code
kept.desc: The comment says layouts read `x-nonce` and pass it to `<Script>` tags, but no consumer exists (the layout explicitly declines to read it), so this header and its rationale are stale.

kept.title: `await headers()` in the root layout forces every route dynamic
kept.desc: Opting the root layout out of static rendering disables static generation and full-route caching for the entire app just to trigger the proxy; the proxy already runs on all matched requests, so this cost is only needed for pages that would otherwise be prerendered with a baked-in nonce.

kept.title: Matcher lookahead is prefix-based, not segment-based
kept.desc: `(?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico)` also excludes unrelated routes whose first segment merely starts with those strings (e.g. `/api-docs`, `/favicon.ico.txt`), silently dropping CSP for them; anchor with a trailing `/` or `$` (e.g. `api(?:/|$)`).
